description: Creates or updates one AI tool in Development from gemmein/ai/tools/<name>.json's contents (label, provider, model or alias, credits, kind, instructions, inputs, bounds…). On an existing tool the dashboard's commerce (label, credits, lock, enabled) stands, as with sync. The AI provider's key is not entered here — provider_key returns the founder's link for it. This is what a founder may call an AI feature or a chatbot — and, on provider external, a pipeline: a paid job on their own server, AI or not, where Gemmein holds the price, sends the run to the tool's URL and settles the units the server reports.
name: put_ai_tool
title: Save an AI tool
